prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 个人所得税专项附加扣除标准简表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "扣除项目" spans 1 col × 2 row; "每月标准（元）" spans 2 col × 1 row; "适用条件" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "扣除项目" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 133px
  col 2: header "每月标准（元） › 一般地区" · longest unbreakable word 37px · one-line width 203px
  col 3: header "每月标准（元） › 特殊情形" · longest unbreakable word 48px · one-line width 435px
  col 4: header "适用条件" · longest unbreakable word 39px · one-line width 1038px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 440px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 439px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"概览个人所得税专项附加扣除项目、每月标准及适用条件，帮助读者查找相关扣除。","reading":"先按首列找到扣除项目，再横向比较一般地区与特殊情形的标准，并阅读适用条件；每行应保持清晰的整体。","groups":["第二、三列同属每月标准，应便于并排比较；第三列的特殊情形说明也与第四列的适用条件相互关联。"],"keep_intact":["扣除金额及其单位","项目名称中的关键短语","一般地区和特殊情形的列标题"],"may_wrap":["较长的扣除项目名称可按自然词组换行","金额后的地区或家庭情形说明","适用条件中的完整句子；同一行其他单元格可利用该行已有高度换行"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [88, 85, 91, 175] · table 440×1128px · row heights [36, 36, 176, 153, 176, 176, 176, 199] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [85, 85, 78, 191] · table 440×1151px · row heights [36, 60, 246, 153, 176, 153, 153, 176] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 10 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [85, 85, 100, 169] · table 440×1198px · row heights [36, 36, 176, 153, 199, 199, 199, 199] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"两个标准子标题均保持单行，金额与对应说明容易横向比较；适用条件有相对充足的宽度，六个项目的行高也较均衡。","problems":"“3岁以下婴幼儿照护”和“住房贷款利息”在首列被切成较短的行；特殊情形中的境外教育说明较窄，文字向下堆叠。","cause":"首列88px、特殊情形列91px扣除边距后，可用于文字的宽度分别仅为67px和70px。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"适用条件列较宽，长句的阅读节奏较顺，部分项目的行高有所降低。","problems":"“特殊情形”标题换行，境外教育说明被挤成很长的一列，使子女教育行明显过高；标准组的两个子列也失去均衡。","cause":"特殊情形列仅78px，文字区为57px；增加到适用条件列的宽度以压缩相邻标准列为代价。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"特殊情形列较宽，标题保持单行，部分金额与说明的组合更紧凑，两个标准列也容易并排查看。","problems":"适用条件多处换成较短的行，后几项的行高持续增加，长句阅读较零碎；首列的长项目名称仍较拥挤。","cause":"适用条件列169px，文字区仅148px；首列85px，文字区仅64px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"refine-A","widths":[94,85,91,169],"change":"以r1A为基础，将首列加宽6px，改善长项目名称的分行；保持两个标准子列宽度，观察适用条件列缩窄后的行高变化。"},{"name":"conditions-first","widths":[88,82,89,180],"change":"保留足以让两个标准子标题单行显示的宽度，为适用条件增加5px，测试长句能否更顺畅，同时避免r1B中特殊情形列过窄。"},{"name":"balanced-standards","widths":[92,80,96,171],"change":"适度加宽项目名和特殊情形列，从一般地区列腾出空间，测试较复杂的特殊情形说明能否更紧凑，同时给适用条件保留足够宽度。"}]}
